summary: Backpack snatched by a scooter rider in Naples
story: On the evening of July 14 I was walking back to my hostel in Naples with my backpack over one shoulder. A scooter came up behind me and the passenger pulled the backpack off my arm, and they were gone before I understood what had happened. I went to the Carabinieri station the next morning and made a report. It is in Italian and it is somewhere in my paperwork from the trip, so I will send it over when I find it. In the backpack were my tablet, a rain jacket and my sunglasses. I have attached the receipts I could find.
